5051.title: ACP pre-prompt reconciliation retains launch-time selection
5051.rootCauseOneLine: ACP pre-prompt reconciliation updates environment and permission settings but never reconciles the current turn's model, effort, or tier; recovery reuses the launch-time selection.
5051.proposedFix: Reconcile current per-input selection before prompting; retain acknowledged native configuration and agent updates; update recovery construction and restart CLI-only selections only under an explicit history-preservation policy.
5051.caveats: Synthetic stdio ACP reproduction on trusted main source, repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout. No real OpenCode inference, desktop UI, paid model, or CLI-only live switch was exercised. No automatic fix PR: switching a non-restorable CLI-only agent requires a product decision between rejecting the switch and losing in-agent history.
